issues.on_page: Combining Statement - General Fund, Inheritance Tax Fund column: Inheritance tax 427,362; Transfers - in 1,622,537; Transfers - out (1,883,166)
issues.issue: Detail covers only the General Fund sub-fund from the p14 budget schedule (receipts 9,133,334). The Inheritance Tax Fund column on p5 (part of Total General Fund 9,560,696 on p4) is not in detail at all, so detail transfers don't net to zero (detail ins 7,584,016 vs outs 7,323,387; difference 260,629 = this column's net transfers). The notes say p5 'has the same totals' as p14, which is wrong: p5 Total General Fund receipts are 9,560,696, p14 receipts are 9,133,334.

The General Fund 'Taxes' line is not split (detail_category is 'taxes (unlabeled)', with review saying there's no breakdown by fund), but category is 'property tax'. The rules say an unsplit combined tax line is 'taxes (unlabeled)' in both fields. The line probably includes motor vehicle tax as well (county-wide motor vehicle 428,289 isn't in any other fund's taxes).

Recorded entirely as 'other' (16% of governmental receipts). The Statement of Activities (p2) adds up to this line exactly: charges for services 1,100,842 + interest income 305,751 + miscellaneous 1,414,057 = 2,820,650. The extractor used the same page to split Taxes, so a split (charges for services/fees, investment income, other) could be made the same way. The same goes for the 'Local' detail lines (detail[2], detail[30], detail[47]).

The category rules list noxious weed control under natural resources/conservation. Using streets/highways because the line sits under the Public Works heading is defensible, and the line is already marked review.

Highway Allocation Bond Fund disbursements 414,226 (p18) were split into principal 355,000 and interest 59,226 using that fund's column on p4 (the split is printed, and the arithmetic holds). Because of the split, the printed final budget 1,245,872 was dropped from both items.
